data.name: Fog
data.detailed_description:
An abnormal fog has engulfed the city.

Visibility is reduced to just a few meters, and the outside world has fallen silent.

Your base is a safe underground shelter.
However, to survive, you must venture outside.

Within the fog, you will find:

  • Abandoned houses

  • Ruined supermarkets

  • Streets that only retain traces of former lives

And beyond the fog —
something is out there.

■ Gameplay Features

First-Person Survival FPS

  • Combat is only one means of survival, not the goal

  • Choosing when to run, hide, or wait is critical

Exploration & Resource Management

  • Gather food, tools, and materials to stay alive

  • Careless decisions can lead to instant death

Underground Base

  • A completely safe location

  • The only place for crafting, storage, and preparation

Intense Tension Created by Dense Fog

  • Constant anxiety caused by limited visibility

  • Sound, shadows, and distance amplify fear

About the Changing World

In this city, the layout of buildings and the resources you can obtain mysteriously change every day.

A house you found yesterday may not exist today.
Even if you head to the same location, an entirely different scene may unfold before you.

One thing is certain —
past experience will not carry over to the next day.

Every expedition is always unknown,
and it is your moment-to-moment decisions—not memory—that determine life or death.

■ Intended Experience

This game does not aim to deliver flashy action or endless combat.

  • The fear of taking a single step into the fog

  • The decision of “Should I go back now, or keep going?”

  • The relief of safely returning underground

It offers a survival experience that tests the player’s judgment and psychology.

■ Development Status

This game is currently in Early Development.

The following elements will be added gradually:

  • Expanded exploration and crafting systems

  • More enemy and threat variations

  • Enhanced visuals and sound design

Player feedback will directly influence development
as we continue to deepen fear and immersion.

■ Streaming & Let’s Play Policy

Streaming and Let’s Play videos are fully welcome.

  • Available on all platforms (YouTube, Twitch, NicoNico, etc.)

  • No prior permission or contact required

  • Monetization is allowed

  • Open to both individuals and organizations

Credits or store page links are not required,
but are greatly appreciated and support development.

Feel free to stream and share the game freely.

data.short_description: Survive in a city shrouded in dense fog. A fog that steals your vision. Scarce supplies. Unknown entities lurking beyond sight. This is not a game about fighting — it is a game about survival.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11（64-bit）
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i9-10900 / AMD Ryzen 9 5900X
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD RX 6600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
